verdict.rationale: Cursor ships an official CLI (cursor-probe-1) and documents 'always-on agents that run on schedules or triggers' (cursor-docs-9) and background agents operating on their own machines (cursor-docs-12), suggesting some headless/automation capability. However, there is no explicit documentation of CI integration, non-interactive flags, exit codes, or GitHub Actions usage. Missing for 10: documented CI/CD pipeline examples, explicit headless-mode flags/exit-code behavior, and independent confirmation of running in automated pipelines.
